description: Continue a completed task's conversation: creates a NEW task that sends the earlier prompt, the model's reply and this text to the same provider and model, and runs at the next clean window before its deadline (default one hour). Costs one provider call. Only completed tasks accept a reply; failed or cancelled tasks are rejected. Returns the new task id and its scheduled time.

deadline.description: Optional ISO-8601 deadline for the reply. Defaults to one hour from now.

task_id.description: The id of the completed task to reply to.

name: reply_task
